Title: Generally Available: Custom kubelet configuration for Windows in AKS

Body.Content:
Custom kubelet configuration for Windows is now generally available in AKS. It allows you to modify certain default supported kubelet parameters for your Windows nodepools.

Currently supported parameters can be found in the AKS documentation. If you’d like additional parameters supported, make a request on our AKS Github.

Learn more.
